name: Hot Property
source: Hot Property is a brisk, playful adult visual novel about a somewhat unlucky guy who lands the kind of break most people only dream about—and promptly turns it into a comedy of errors. Expect cheeky humor, surreal twists, consensual kink, and a generous dose of NSFW chaos.​
